Method of Attack: Click-fraud malware that infects computers and clicks on invisible ads on the user's behalf
Ransomware distributed as a second-stage download by Kovter campaigns
Ransomware distributed by Kovter, for which a decrypter was created
Banking trojan distributed by Necurs botnet
Discoverer: Security firms Avast and Check Point
Security researchers Kevin Beaumont, MalwareTech, MalwareHunterTeam, PhishMe
Fabian Wosar of Emsisoft (decrypter for Nemucod)
Impacted Systems: Computers infected by Kovter click-fraud malware
Attack Vector: Spam emails sent via compromised websites (e.g., Joomla) running mailer scripts
Necurs botnet infected PCs sending spam emails
Botnet of PCs infected with Necurs bootkit
